approved_targets.reference_rto_scope: The fenced operator procedure on the idle reference deployment. About two times the observed maximum of 54.82 seconds.
approved_targets.rpo_valkey_restart_persistent: Zero acknowledged writes with appendfsync always persistent data. Measured zero in three runs.
approved_targets.rpo_empty_target_import: Zero acknowledged writes after the fence. Measured zero in three runs.
approved_targets.rpo_replica_promotion: The writes that only the old primary acknowledged after the divergence. The product does not bound this count. Documented limit.

accepted_limits: Component test duration is not deployment RTO.
A laboratory zero-loss result is not a blanket production RPO guarantee.
Populated adoption supports only a zero prefix. The operator attests the interval between the fence and the capture. Software cannot detect an acknowledged write that Valkey lost in a restart.
The promotion RPO stays unbounded until the product bounds replication lag or adds synchronous acknowledgement. Neither is in scope.
permission: Missing independent security or budget history keeps affected admission restricted regardless of a recovery objective.
